title: Russian strikes on processing plants drive up Ukraine rapeseed export prices
summary: Rapeseed export prices in Ukraine rose by UAH 500-1,000 per tonne over the past week after Russian strikes on processing facilities disrupted oilseed processing operations.

title: Debris of Russian Gerbera-2 drone found in Moldova
summary: Debris from a Russian Gerbera-2-type drone was discovered near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.

title: Russian strikes on energy infrastructure cause power outages in five regions
summary: Russian forces attacked power generation facilities and electricity transmission and distribution infrastructure over the past 24 hours. As of the morning, consumers in the Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv and Sumy regions remained without electricity.

title: Russian forces attack Shostka, damaging four apartment buildings
summary: Russian drones have struck civilian infrastructure in Shostka, Sumy region, destroying non-residential premises and damaging four apartment buildings.

title: Drone attack reported on Kaleykino oil pumping station in Russia's Tatarstan
summary: Residents of Almetyevsk in Russia's Tatarstan region recorded flashes near the village of Kaleykino, where an oil pumping station of the Russian trunk oil pipeline system of the same name is located. Local authorities confirmed a drone attack on oil storage tanks.

title: Trump proposes Xi join talks with Putin on ending war in Ukraine
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump told Chinese President Xi Jinping at a meeting in Shenzhen that the two leaders should work together to end Russia's war in Ukraine and discuss the issue at a summit with Russian ruler Vladimir Putin.

title: U.S. dollar and euro exchange rates on November 19
summary: The U.S. dollar and the euro both fell by UAH 0.14 and UAH 0.28, respectively.

title: Russian forces strike industrial and energy infrastructure in Odesa region overnight
summary: Russian forces launched a massive combined attack on the south of the Odesa region overnight on November 19, damaging industrial and energy infrastructure facilities.

title: Ukraine approves drinking water supply improvement program through 2035
summary: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers has approved a state targeted program to improve drinking water supply through 2035.

title: Trump holds ‘pull-aside’ talks with Putin in China
summary: A meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian ruler Vladimir Putin in China ended after approximately 40 minutes.

title: Four people injured in Russian drone attacks on two districts of Kyiv region over past day
summary: Russian forces attacked the Vyshhorod and Fastiv districts of the Kyiv region with attack drones over the past day, injuring four people.

title: Zelensky discusses investment promotion and business innovation with Markarova
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed investment and business innovation measures aimed at strengthening Ukraine's economic resilience with Oksana Markarova, an adviser on reconstruction and investment.

title: War update: 211 attacks on front lines over past day, most on Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka axes
summary: On November 19, a total of 211 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the front line, with the largest number of Russian attacks on the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka axes.

title: Train services on Crimean Bridge suspended after overnight drone attack – media
summary: Train services on the Kerch Strait Bridge have been temporarily suspended.

title: Zelensky announces measures to help unblock agricultural exports
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced measures aimed at helping unblock agricultural exports.

title: Air defense downs 69 drones launched by Russia in overnight attack on Ukraine
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 69 of the 98 drones Russia used to attack Ukraine from the evening of November 18.

title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure in Mykolaiv region
summary: Russian drones have attacked energy and civilian infrastructure in the Mykolaiv region, leaving 99 settlements without electricity.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll up by 1,970 over past day
summary: Russian forces have suffered approximately 1,630,980 combat losses since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, to November 19, 2026, including 1,970 personnel killed or wounded in action over the past 24 hours.

title: Norway's foreign minister: Europe's security architecture worked well until Russia violated it
summary: Europe's current security architecture does not need to be revised, as it functioned properly until Russia violated it.

title: Lithuania's military aid to Ukraine will not decrease next year – defense minister
summary: Lithuania's military assistance to Ukraine will not decrease next year and will amount to 0.25% of the country's GDP.

title: Russian assault troops in Kherson region's island zone readily surrender – press officer
summary: Many Russian servicemen sent to storm the islands in the Dnipro River delta near Kherson readily surrender to Ukrainian forces.

title: Zelensky believes Trump and Xi could pressure Putin into ending Ukraine war
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky believes that the United States and China have enough influence to pressure Russian leader Vladimir Putin into ending the war.

title: Putin is lying again: Carney responds to claim that “sanctions are a thing of the past”
summary: Sanctions against Russia must remain in place until the war in Ukraine ends.

title: Ukrainian law enforcers, FBI expose hacking network that stole data and demanded multimillion-dollar ransoms
summary: The Ukrainian Prosecutor General’s Office, in cooperation with the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), has exposed an international criminal organization whose members carried out large-scale cyberattacks on foreign companies and demanded ransoms totaling more than $40 million.

title: 19-year-old woman suspected of murdering Colombian national who served in Ukrainian army
summary: A 19-year-old woman in Kyiv has been notified of suspicion of the intentional murder of a Colombian national who previously served in the Ukrainian Armed Forces.

title: Ukrainian military ready to conduct further civilian evacuations from occupied Kherson region – press officer
summary: Ukrainian military personnel are prepared to carry out further evacuations of civilians from temporarily occupied areas of the Kherson region, even if this allows Russian forces to reinforce their units.
